tests: Missing configuration is unavailable, with no provider calls or phantom login
Explicit ownership, HTTPS origins, 32-byte key, and nonprivileged hosted backend are required
Provider flags are independent and email requires custom SMTP confirmation
Exact mandatory Origin, Host, fetch metadata and method checks reject forged POSTs
Stable sealed CSRF rejects wrong/Unicode values without server error
OAuth own state is in the fixed callback URL; S256 verifier stays server-only
Wrong/missing/duplicate state and duplicate cookies fail before token exchange
Cancelled/errors are sanitized and expired OAuth flow cannot be exchanged
OAuth provider exchange or server-user rejection never creates a login
Session identity is revalidated with getUser on every status; no token leaks
Email request alone is not login, with explicit create_user and encrypted email binding
Email verification is bound to request cookie, then getUser confirms matching email
Invalid/expired email code or unconfirmed/mismatched server email stays signed out
Refresh is explicit, keeps absolute lifetime and subject, and coalesces same-instance requests
Wrong refresh subject or provider failure cannot silently restore a session
Held refresh cannot reissue account cookies after concurrent logout on this process
Successful signout revokes local GoTrue refresh session and expires only auth cookies
Provider 401/502 and malformed/expired sessions can be removed locally without claiming remote revocation
Tampered/mismatched cookie pair fails closed; oversized provider tokens create no cookie pair
Deletion is fail-closed and CSRF required; JSON bounds and open redirects are rejected
Upstream redirects/non-JSON/oversized bodies/network failures are bounded and sanitized
Per-instance OTP throttle limits repeated requests without storing raw email in response
Account client contains no token persistence, ghost identity, Premium entitlement, or provider secret
Actual account HTML stays honest when API missing/HTML/unexpected shape/network down and supports retry
Native account HTML makes no BFF calls and never offers fake OAuth
Account OTP UI requires verification plus fresh server status, and never treats send as login
Account identity is hidden and rechecked after focus; provider-failed signout retains honest local-only message
Refresh and signout share one Web Lock across tabs; logout waits for the active refresh
Without Web Locks refresh is disabled, while explicit browser-session removal remains available
BroadcastChannel carries only account-change notification and triggers a fresh status check
scope: Offline synthetic GoTrue REST and actual account HTML. No provider, email, deployment, real-user or native sign-in was exercised.
